name: Circuit Candidate Discovery & Neighborhood Retrieval
description: Locate candidate neurons matching evidence-grounded biological concept mappings and retrieve their local synaptic neighborhoods within the MaleCNS connectome.
graph_scope_constraints: Bounded to local 1-hop presynaptic and postsynaptic partners (default max 30-150 nodes).
expected_result_structure: List of candidate neurons with body IDs, verified cell types, matching criteria, and directed partner graph.
limitations: Retrieves structural synaptic partners within the loaded subset; does not infer functional excitation or inhibition without receptor verification.

name: Detailed Neuron Profile & Connectivity Intelligence
description: Inspect anatomical, neurotransmitter, and connectivity intelligence for verified neurons identified by biological concepts.
graph_scope_constraints: Single neuron focus with paginated incoming and outgoing partner connection tables.
expected_result_structure: Structured profile metadata, pre/post synaptic site counts, total synaptic weights, and partner tables.
limitations: Body-level statistics reflect full segmented body sites; connection tables reflect traced-only connectome weights subset.

name: Directed Structural Pathway Tracing Between Circuits
description: Find directed multi-hop synaptic routes connecting sensory circuit candidates (e.g. LC4 or T4) to motor or descending targets (e.g. DNp01 or TTMn).
graph_scope_constraints: Constrained to directed paths up to 6 hops within the traced connectome weights.
expected_result_structure: Ranked path sequences with hops, bottleneck weights, total synaptic weights, and intermediate neuron annotations.
limitations: Shows structural paths; does not establish biological spike conduction or timing delays.

name: Downstream Divergence Cascade Analysis
description: Analyze multi-hop divergent reachability cascades originating from verified biological concept neurons.
graph_scope_constraints: Breadth-first expansion bounded by hop distance (default 2-4 hops) and node cap (300 nodes).
expected_result_structure: Layer-by-layer retention table (newly reached nodes, cumulative reachable population) and directed cascade graph.
limitations: Does not model polysynaptic signal attenuation or synaptic depression.

name: In-Silico Structural Lesion & Resilience Assessment
description: Simulate targeted ablation of concept neurons (e.g., disabling DNp01 or T4 cells) to measure pathway survival and reachability retention penalties (ΔR, ΔH).
graph_scope_constraints: Non-destructive exclusion overlay applied to declared path and cascade scopes.
expected_result_structure: Delta reachability (ΔR), detour penalty (ΔH), surviving routes, lost nodes audit list, and comparison Cytoscape graph.
limitations: Non-destructive graph exclusion only; does not simulate biological cell death, behavioral paralysis, or neural plasticity.
